description: A commit body gets an overflow control when the phone viewport shrinks. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. Open Diffs: on a phone it is in the overflow menu: click the button named "More options", then, in its popover (".chat-overflow-popover"), the button whose accessible name starts with "Diffs" (".overflow-toolbar-action[aria-label=\"Diffs\"]"). The ".diff-viewer-overlay" should be visible. The ".diff-viewer-rethink .diff-commit-message" is visible and contains no button named "Show more". Resize to 390x500; its "Show more" button becomes visible. Click it; "Show less" is visible. Resize to 390x844, click "Show less"; there are zero "Show more" buttons in the message.
